title: Gmail API error details
blurb: Gmail sync activity and Debug log show HTTP status, a fixed operation and recognized Google reason/status codes. They distinguish quota or rate limits, missing mail permission, a disabled API and domain policy when Google supplies evidence. Unknown causes stay unknown. Raw error bodies, provider text, URLs, ids, mail content, addresses and tokens are omitted from these diagnostics. Gmail sync Debug records omit the mailbox address, folder name and folder id; sync activity still shows that mailbox and folder. Other Debug entries may still identify an account or folder. Only a quota classification pauses for quota or rate limits. Sync fetches up to 20 Gmail messages per folder pass. This counts actual message reads across history, bootstrap, cached verification and legacy Sent inspection. Pending pages resume from saved positions; a waiting message open goes ahead after the current read. Gmail sync and body downloads space reads to stay under the per-user quota. A quota pause honors Retry-After, capped at 15 minutes. The first two pauses are 30 seconds when Google does not say how long; later pauses grow from 2 minutes up to 15 minutes. Reads are spaced; writes are not. Sign-in success alone does not identify a later 403; these details do not prove its cause. No new scopes or automatic write retries are added.
